nom: IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cleanser Gentle Face Wash

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many report no burning, no reactions and improved comfort even with rosacea or allergies, while a vocal minority describe fragrance-triggered breakouts, eczema flares or tightness.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers consistently describe the cleanser as non-stripping and moisturizing, though one reviewer with dry skin still found it left her face dry and tight.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe thorough cleansing without dryness or new breakouts, including on combo-oily and combo-acne-prone skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with combo-oily/sensitive skin says the cleanser does not add oiliness or cause breakouts.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 40s to 70s report soft, smooth, hydrated skin and long-term daily use without dryness or irritation.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically identify normal, non-sensitized skin as a distinct category.

concerns.aging: Reviewers aged 46 to 71 report smooth, soft skin and one credits it with an improved complexion and few wrinkles, though this is attributed to overall skincare rather than the cleanser alone.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not strip or dry the skin and leaves it moisturized; a small number report the opposite, feeling dry and tight afterward.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers say it visibly reduces redness, while one reports redness improved only after the first use with no further change and another with sensitive/rosacea-prone skin finds it calming.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits switching to this gentler cleanser with letting her stripped, raw skin barrier recover after over-exfoliating with a previous product.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with rosacea-prone skin objects that a fragranced cleanser is marketed as suitable for rosacea, while another with rosacea reports it works well and feels light.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say it clears or controls acne and mild teenage breakouts without irritation, but others report it caused whiteheads, painful breakouts, or eczema-like flaking soon after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: One combination/oily-skin reviewer reports it is moisturizing without adding oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way

extraits.titre: Not for sensitive skin, will break you out!
extraits.texte: I'm not sure how this cleanser can be marketed as "sensitive" at all. The fragrance is so over powering and it left my face feeling so dry and tight even after using face lotion. This was the only new product I added to my routine and within two days my face and neck were covered in tiny painful whiteheads that took awhile to fully go away. Do not use this product.

This has given me the most horrible itchy flaking eczema I have ever had on my face/specifically around my nose. It is not fragrance free like I have read in some reviews(smells like a dreamsicle which is nice albeit strong) I have used other cleansers with some fragrance and have never had this issue. A friend had the same issue with this product and neither of us have what I would consider to be traditional sensitive skin. This was the only new addition to my skincare routine and I do not wear makeup/no change in detergents or other factors to cause a flare up in my skin, and I am still struggling to get the eczema under control and stop spreading.

this is the best I've ever used !!! I'm 57 ,I have very sensitive skin ,ive used alot of cleansers , this leaves your skin soft,not tight ! it leaves it moisturized not dry ! it's the best , give it a try you won't be disappointed!! a little goes a long way ! Just a dab ,massage it in , it feels good !!!

I stumbled across a free sample size bottle of this that i threw in my skin care bag, one day and forgot about. Let me you, WOWWW!! I was pleasantly surprised to learn that this cleanser works great for my skin, which is combination/sensitive and acne prone. I always double cleanse with an oil before a gel or cream cleanser so I can't really speak on the make up removal aspect. However, this cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean without stripping it. It works exactly how it says. It's a cleanser and a serum in one. This is everything I've been looking for and I don't ever consider myself needing anything else again. I've heard that glycerin cleansers work well for sensitive/dry skin and it's my first glycerin type cleanser, and I think that was the secret all along!! I love how soft yet clean my face feels after using this. I love that. It's also vegan alcohol, free soap, free, and non-comedogenic. For such a long time, I thought that I needed harsh cleansers to take all my makeup off and ensure I wouldn't break out because I am acne prone and while I wasn't breaking out anymore, my skin barrier was stripped, raw, red and irritated. I was exfoliating way too much because the cleanser I used to use had exfoliating beads and I was using that every day, sometimes twice a day. My poor skin!!! 2026 is gonna be to beautiful skin for me and I'm excited!!! 🥂✨ BUY THE CLEANSER!!

I have combo skin and I've tried many face washes but this one remains my favorite. It makes my skin feel very clean and eliminates all my makeup. I personally feel it keeps my skin clear as well and I have sensitive skin. The consistency is perfect and I love that there's anti aging properties as well. I've tried finding alternatives but nothing compares.

extraits.titre: Moisturizing, silky, good for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I have been using Confidence in a Cleanser for quite a few years. It cleans thoroughly but gently. I love the silky moisturizing texture of it too. It's great even on my sensitive rosacea prone skin. It feels light, not heavy. I will continue using it every day. I think it's fabulous.

I have extremely sensitive, dry, irritated skin. This cleanser is perfect for everyday use. It doesn't smell amazing and it's a bit pricey, but it makes my skin feel incredible and clean. Well worth the money. I will continue to purchase it.
